description: Create assets/premium-announcement-bar.js - vanilla JS (IIFE pattern) implementing all announcement bar interactive behaviors: slider fade transitions, marquee continuous scroll, countdown timer, auto-rotate with progress bar, dismiss with localStorage, pause on hover, navigation, keyboard support, and Shopify editor events
steps: Create assets/premium-announcement-bar.js as a vanilla JavaScript file using an IIFE or self-initializing pattern (NOT ES module import since custom.liquid loads it with defer, not type=module).

1. INITIALIZATION: On DOMContentLoaded, find all premium announcement bar instances by selector '[data-premium-announcement-bar]'. For each, create an instance that reads data attributes for config (display-mode, auto-rotate, rotate-speed, pause-on-hover, dismissed-key, section-id).
2. DISMISS LOGIC: Check localStorage for dismissed key. If found and value is '1', hide the bar immediately (display:none). Close button click saves to localStorage and hides with fade-out animation.
3. SLIDER MODE (fade): Slides stacked with CSS grid. Active slide has opacity:1, others opacity:0. Transition between slides by toggling active class. Track current index, wrap around at ends.

4. MARQUEE MODE: Duplicate the slide content to create seamless loop. Use CSS animation (translateX) for continuous scroll. Animation duration based on marquee_speed setting. Pause animation on hover if pause_on_hover is enabled.
5. STATIC MODE: Show only first slide, hide all others. No transitions, no auto-rotate.
6. AUTO-ROTATE: setInterval at rotate_speed * 1000ms. Advances to next slide. Clears and restarts on manual navigation.

7. PROGRESS BAR: Thin bar element at bottom of announcement bar. Animates width from 0% to 100% over the rotate_speed duration using CSS transition. Resets on slide change. Synced to auto-rotate interval.
8. NAVIGATION ARROWS: Click handlers for prev/next buttons. Each click advances/retreats slide index, resets auto-rotate timer.
9. DOT NAVIGATION: Click handler on each dot sets current slide to matching index. Updates active dot class.
10. KEYBOARD NAVIGATION: Listen for ArrowLeft/ArrowRight when bar is focused or hovered. Left goes prev, Right goes next.
11. PAUSE ON HOVER: mouseenter pauses auto-rotate and progress bar animation. mouseleave resumes. Only active if pause_on_hover data attribute is true.

12. COUNTDOWN TIMER: Find all elements with [data-countdown-end] attribute. Parse ISO date. setInterval every 1 second to update days/hours/minutes/seconds spans. When expired, optionally hide the countdown or show 'Expired'.

13. SHOPIFY EDITOR EVENTS: Listen for shopify:section:load, shopify:section:select, shopify:block:select, shopify:block:deselect events. On block:select, pause auto-rotate and navigate to selected block's slide. On block:deselect, resume auto-rotate. On section:load, re-initialize the bar.
14. RESPONSIVE: On window resize, recalculate any dynamic dimensions if needed. Marquee duplication may need adjustment.
15. CLEANUP: Provide a destroy method that clears all intervals/timeouts and removes event listeners, used on section:unload.
acceptance_criteria: assets/premium-announcement-bar.js exists and is valid JavaScript
File uses IIFE or self-initializing pattern (not ES module exports)
Implements slider mode with opacity-based fade transitions
Implements marquee mode with CSS translateX animation
Implements static mode showing only first message
Auto-rotate with configurable speed and progress bar sync
Countdown timer that updates every second
Shopify editor event handlers (block:select, section:load, etc.)
findings: All verification checks passed: JS syntax valid, localStorage used, keyboard nav present, editor events present, countdown logic present. File uses IIFE pattern with prototype-based class. 439 lines total.
